comparison.objective: Manually track a moving figure with a camera head and press stop on a timed signal; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous visual tracking plus timed bimanual button actuation versus fine mechanical adjustment and repeated physical-cycle inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Aim error/time bounds and a prompt stop press versus bounded damper stroke, no hard-stop impact and stable adjustment.
comparison.reason: The shared physical control press is incidental; tracking and reaction timing do not test tool-based mechanical tuning. Candidate does not quantify rebound, overload, drift or witness torque.
